traditional: No classical doctrine: Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Identity meets power and intensity. A magnetic, high-voltage presence that others react to immediately. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

cyclic.meaning: A new cycle of selfhood and power is sown: instinctive, full of potential, not yet conscious of itself.

business: Concentrated focus in this area. Real influence; the intensity tends to polarize people.
shadow: Egotism and needing to be the center fused with control and obsession, with no distance to tell them apart.
arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.
base: A decision can become much more intense once getting the outcome starts to feel tied to proving who holds the power.

readerCopy.body: A decision can become much more intense once getting the outcome starts to feel tied to proving who holds the power. When the Sun conjoins Pluto, purpose and power fuse, concentrating ambition, desire, fear, and control around whatever feels most consequential. The aspect can bring enough force to confront something that has been avoided and enough intensity to turn a solvable disagreement into a standoff. Power is most useful when it changes the condition that matters rather than merely establishing who won.
